name: Martyr / Heretic
life_theme: Learn through experimentation and trial, then become the practical problem-solver for others.
work_pattern: Build wisdom through lived experience — the 3 line tries, adjusts, and tries again. This produces deep practical knowledge. The 5 line means others will project their needs onto you and seek your solutions.
career_approach: Embrace career experimentation. Multiple roles and industries across a career is the design, not a failure. Each 'failure' produces real wisdom. When you become known as someone who has done the work, the right invitations come.
growth_edge: Releasing shame about past 'failures' — they are the raw material of your expertise.
